notes: Baseline seeded manually on 2026-10-21 (first state file for this contract). ath.price_usd is the true all-time high (CoinGecko, 2026-05-28), not the tracking-start price, so the ATH gate cannot false-fire until the token genuinely exceeds it. Targets pre-registered from aeon.yml var so a crossing between runs is caught rather than swallowed by the skill's first-observation rule. h1_pct is stored as null when no trade occurred in the window (DexScreener omits h1 rather than printing 0) - do not read null as 'flat'. CLASSIFYING BUYS, seven tells: (1) a single-venue print from a wallet that KEEPS the balance is directional; (2) a same-block sweep of 4-5 pools into one hop then forwarded to a shared sink that ends at 0 balance is arb/aggregator; (3) the SAME sender buying in one pool and selling in another within the same second is a two-leg arb - apply this to SELLS too; (4) a wallet whose eth_getCode starts 0xef0100 is an EIP-7702 delegated smart account, not a fresh bot EOA - check the designator; (5) buy/sell COUNT is not buy/sell DOLLARS on a thin book; (6) a BUY can be fake too - at 16:41:51Z a $81 VIRTUAL + $250 USDC same-second dual-pool sweep looked like a buyer wave, but the sender is a plain EOA (code 0x, nonce 3,549) with balanceOf exactly 0, i.e. a pass-through router filling someone else's order. A buy only counts if the buyer's balance RISES and stays; (7) a buy from an INCUMBENT large holder may be a REBUY after selling earlier in the same session - at 17:06:13Z the $135 two-pool sweep came from 0x09b383a6, which holds 2.14M DEUS and had sold $247 into the 14:55Z bid; its balance is still 6.6k DEUS BELOW where it started the afternoon. Always compare balanceOf now against 24h/48h ago, not just the trade's direction, before calling an uptick accumulation. Always balanceOf the receiver before calling an uptick accumulation - encode balanceOf calldata as selector + 24 hex zeros + the 40-hex address (74 hex chars), never zero-pad the address on the right.
